documents.r01: Rotate API credentials every ninety days. Record the rotation date in the audit log.
documents.r02: Request elevated access through the approval queue. An owner reviews the request.
documents.r03: Run restore drills quarterly. Record elapsed time and recovery point.
documents.r04: Use hybrid retrieval for exact identifiers and semantic search.
documents.r05: Document scope follows the user role. Policy checks run before retrieval.
documents.r06: Review failed backups each morning. Escalate repeated failures to the owner.
